data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50 tons, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-term.
